title: Soldiers Field, Chicago, the Steamer Capitol group and the Bureus orange grove
summary: Notes of father's Chicago brass band job (a white band), leading an unnamed group on the Steamer Capitol, and playing at a citrus garden in Bureus.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I have a little note here where he played at Soldiers Field in Chicago. In Chicago. Mm-hmm. And he also played at the Farmers Band, but I don't remember the name, but it was in 1970.
And Soldiers Field, I think, was pretty late, wasn't it?
Soldiers Field, that wasn't too long before he died.
No, because I think they built that shortly before the World's Fair up there.
That's when I'm, he died in 33. 33. And that was about, oh, I'd say about five years before he died.
Do you remember which band he was with when he went to Chicago at that time? Did he put it, a dance band or a brass?
No, it was a brass band.
Brass band. Because he, my mother has a picture of him in that band. That was also a white band.
And I'm trying to think of the artists. He, he played the Steamer Capitol. Oh, yes.
Do you remember whose band that was? Was that his own band or somebody like Pierone or?
No, I think that was just a group of men he got together. Mm-hmm. And, you know, they played in other words. The Steamer Capitol. He was the leader of that band. Yes. But there was no name to it.
Yes, usually the cornettists was the leader of the chorus group.

Just a group of men that they played there. Mm-hmm. And I've mentioned the roof guard. I think there's, you know, another place he played? I don't know how prominent a place it was, but it was a citrus garden. I don't know, that was in the country someplace. He played there quite a while. You played, did you ever play there?
Down in, down in, down in Bureus. Bureus, that's it. They have a big, uh, Orange Festival every, about October. That's it. In Bureus.
Oh, yeah. They used to go there every evening. That's where it was. In Bureus. Uh-huh. Or, that's the Orange Grove, huh?

At that time, at that time, it just started at 8, to get to Bureus there to leave you about 2, 3 and even if they were riding, unless you catch the little train at Canal and River. You just come all the way to Canal and River and have a little train. Right. But if you go in the car, it would take you 3 to 4 hours to get the Bureus down the road, you know what I'm saying?
